_doc: Published Steam Workshop item ids, one per package (tools/workshop.py, docs/WORKSHOP.md). After a package's first upload, put the id from its Workshop page URL (?id=...) here, so the next build says Update instead of Upload new. hold: not published yet, and why. tags: the item's Workshop tags (the game's tag list: Addon, Gameplay, Player Class, Equipment, Mission, Graphics, Item Pack, Total Conversion, Language, Other). tools/workshop_publish.py fills item_id when it creates an item.

HWP-classes.hold: the HoH1 classes are parked (hidden from character creation), so this package only adds the Skill 4-6 keys; publish it when they are back
